showcase.subtitle: Built for clarity and connection.

language.heading: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the app.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.description: Light, dark, or follow your system. The choice is saved to your account and applies across devices.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.description: Get a system notification when you receive a message in a background tab.
notifications.deniedHint: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then reload the page.
notifications.unsupportedHint: Your browser doesn't support web push notifications.

errors.permissionDismissed: You closed the permission prompt. Click the switch again to retry.
errors.vapidLoadFailed: Couldn't load notification settings from the server. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.subscribeFailed: Couldn't enable notifications. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rollbackFailed: Notifications are in an inconsistent state. Toggle the switch again to resync.

install.heading: Install app
install.description: Install Chatrix on your device — get its own icon, splash screen, and a window without the browser address bar.
install.installedHint: Chatrix is already installed on this device.
install.iosInstructions: On iOS, open the Share menu in Safari and tap "Add to Home Screen".
install.unsupportedHint: Your browser doesn't expose an install button. Try Chrome, Edge, or Safari (macOS Sonoma+).

fields.usernameHint: Your account handle. Cannot be changed.
fields.bioPlaceholder: A short blurb people see on your profile.

errors.nicknameTooShort: Display name must be at least 2 characters.
errors.nicknameWhitespace: Display name cannot start or end with a space.

storage.heading: Storage
storage.exemptHint: Only chat attachments count toward this limit. Avatars are exempt.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this file?
confirmDelete.description: "{{name}}" will be removed permanently and any chat that referenced it will lose the attachment. This cannot be undone.

chats.title: Chats
chats.emptyListSubtitle: Start a conversation to see it here. Anyone you message will appear in this list.

noSelection.title: No conversation open
noSelection.subtitle: Select a chat from the list, or start a new one with the button below.

newChatDialog.directDescription: Find someone by username or display name to start a conversation.
newChatDialog.groupDescription: Pick a name and invite at least one person.
newChatDialog.groupNameTooLong: Group name must be at most 100 characters.
newChatDialog.typeMore: Type at least {{min}} characters to search.
newChatDialog.createError: Couldn't create the chat. Please try again.
newChatDialog.draftEmpty: Say hi to {{name}} — your message creates the chat.

removeAvatarConfirm.title: Remove group photo?
removeAvatarConfirm.description: Members will see the default group icon instead. You can upload a new photo any time.

addMember.title: Add member
addMember.description: Pick a user to add to this group.

confirmKick.title: Remove {{name}}?
confirmKick.description: They will lose access to this group and its messages. They can be re-added later.

confirmTransfer.title: Transfer ownership to {{name}}?
confirmTransfer.description: They will become the new owner. You will be demoted to admin and will no longer be able to rename, delete, or change member roles in this group.

confirmLeave.title: Leave this group?
confirmLeave.description: You will lose access to the group and its messages. The other members will not be notified.

ownerLeave.title: Leaving as owner
ownerLeave.description: Owners can't leave directly. Choose one of the options below.

deleteOption.label: Delete the entire group
deleteOption.hint: All messages and attachments are removed for every member. Cannot be undone.

transferOption.label: Transfer ownership and leave
transferOption.hint: Pick another member to become the new owner. You will be demoted to admin and then leave the group.
transferOption.disabledHint: There is nobody else in the group to transfer ownership to.

pick.title: Pick the new owner
pick.description: They will become the owner. You will be demoted to admin and immediately leave the group.

direct.title: Delete chat with {{name}}?
direct.description: Choose whether to delete the chat only for you, or for {{name}} as well. Either way, this cannot be undone.

group.title: Delete group {{name}}?
group.description: The group, its messages, and all attachments will be permanently removed for every member. This cannot be undone.

composer.dropSubtitle: Up to {{max}} files per message · {{sizeMb}} MB each

attachments.offline: You are offline. Reconnect and retry.

unsupported.title: Video format not supported
unsupported.description: Your browser can't play {{format}}. Download the file to open it in another player.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this message?
deleteConfirm.description: It will be removed for everyone in this chat. This cannot be undone.

banner.title: Install Chatrix
banner.description: Get a faster, native-app experience with its own icon, splash screen, and window.

iosModal.title: Install Chatrix on iOS
iosModal.description: On iOS, web apps install through Safari only
iosModal.step1: Open this page in Safari, then tap the Share button
iosModal.step2: Scroll the bottom action list and tap "Add to Home Screen"
iosModal.step3: Tap "Add" in the top-right to confirm
